contradict_spans: Genetic screening: negative for mutations predisposing to arrhythmias
Cardiac MRI: EF 50%, no signs of infiltrative process, myocarditis, or ischemic changes
concepts.why: The prolonged QTc interval and elevated troponin level suggest arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy, although genetic screening was negative.
The patient's low potassium level and genetic screening negative for mutations predisposing to arrhythmias suggest that hypokalemia may have contributed to the cardiac arrest.
